verdict.rationale: Codegen is built around delegating tasks to an AI agent that analyzes requirements, implements features, fixes bugs, writes tests, opens PRs, and can be invoked via Slack, CLI, SDK, or API — directly matching an in-product AI assistant users can delegate to. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports corroborating the delegation experience beyond vendor docs, and clearer detail on the interactive in-app assistant UI versus API/CLI-driven delegation.
